title: HD Feynman: FUN TO IMAGINE complete (with optional Chinese subtitles)
summary: A restored HD upload of the 1983 BBC series Fun to Imagine, in which Richard Feynman talks informally about everyday science. Topics include jiggling atoms, fire, rubber bands, magnets, electricity, mirrors, seeing, big numbers and ways of thinking.
why: HN commenters point to it as an equation-free, charming way to hear Feynman explain physics to laypeople, including his famous refusal to explain magnetism with simple analogies.

quote.text: It's an hour of fun science, and especially accessible for anyone who is curious about physics but doesn't enjoy all the equations.
